Record Class HiringRecordDto

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.models.HiringRecordDto
public record HiringRecordDto(Long id, Long applicationId, LocalDateTime formalOfferSentAt, LocalDateTime formalOfferAcceptedAt, NewHireForm newHireForm, LocalDateTime newHireFormAt, LocalDateTime flsaConflictFoundAt, LocalDateTime flsaConflictResolvedAt, LocalDateTime inUcpathAt, LocalDateTime i9CompleteAt, String fundingSource, String staffComments, LocalDateTime updatedAt, String updatedByEmail) extends Record
One HiringRecord as the Soft Offer Results carry it (issue #509): the stamp of each checkbox (null when unchecked), the New Hire form choice and its stamp, the funding source's abbreviation, the staff's comments, and who saved last and when. For admins and hiring staff only; it never travels to an applicant.
